newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks end higher after bank sector rally.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks end higher after bank sector rally.

text.p: Tokyo stocks ended higher on Friday as investors, resuming trade after a public holiday on Thursday, stepped up buying of banking sector shares that had suffered heavy selling in the past few months.
The 225-share Nikkei average added 139.45 points or 0.75 percent to finish at 18,633.16. Its June futures rose 160 points to end at 18,590.

"Wall Street weakened overnight and the Friday session was sandwiched by a holiday and the weekend but banks rallied, to everyone's surprise, and that lifted the market on the whole," said Yasuo Ueki, Nikko Securities general manager.
